scope: Published population and trial parameters for high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) and first-line or maintenance treatment-sequence modeling. Public primary literature only; supports Foundation-0/project-asma PR #47 assumption audits and virtual-human graph reaction experiments. Not fitted to private data.

extends.description: Row identifiers, citation blocks (doi, title, locator) and label vocabulary {KNOWN, CONJECTURE, MISSING} follow the public registry pattern in Foundation-0/project-asma PR #47 (registries/*-sources.json). Quantitative value/range/units/population fields are virtual-human extensions stored under data/clinical/ alongside other provenance-annotated inputs.
